question_content: Review fig_01.jpg and fig_02.jpg. What is the fusion orientation shown?

golden_answer.subjective_directions: The accessory tooth structure is attached on the palatal aspect of the maxillary lateral incisor rather than mesially or distally. That spatial relationship classifies the anomaly as labiopalatal fusion.

answer_explanation: The accessory tooth structure is attached on the palatal aspect of the maxillary lateral incisor rather than mesially or distally. That spatial relationship classifies the anomaly as labiopalatal fusion.
